newsitem.title: UK: Caledonia to get 49.7 mln stg from Bristow.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia to get 49.7 mln stg from Bristow.

text.p: Britain's Caledonia Investments Plc said on Friday it would receive a total of about 49.7 million stg from the sale of a 44 percent stake in Bristow Helicopter Group Ltd to Offshore Logistics Inc.
Caledonia said it would receive 24.5 million stg in cash, as well as 1.3 million common shares and $7.5 million in six percent convertible notes in the U.S. firm.
After the deal, Caledonia would own about six percent of Offshore's common stock and would appoint two directors to its board, the investment company said in a statement.
Caledonia also said it would get a 49 percent shareholding in Bristow Aviation Holdings Ltd, a new holding company formed to buy the entire issued share capital of Bristow Helicopter.
Caledonia said its industrial and services unit would have voting control of Bristol Aviation through a binding agreement with a private investor holding two percent of Bristol's shares.
Offshore will subscribe for 49 percent of Bristol Aviation, as well as 91 million stg of that company's new subordinated loan stock, Caledonia said.
